# Oliver Eichhof

> Oliver Eichhof is a communication specialist from Hamburg, Germany, focused on digital brand management and target audience analysis, shaped by music, media and streaming. This is his personal website, available in German (/de/), English (/en/) and Danish (/da/).

Key facts:

- Entity type: Person
- Role: Marketing Director (Leiter Marketing) at REGIOCAST GmbH & Co. KG, since 2026
- Sector: media, marketing and communication
- Location: Hamburg, Germany
- Born: 1979 in Bremerhaven, Germany
- Languages: German (native), English (fluent), Danish (beginner)
- Experience: around 20 years in agencies and companies, for B2C and B2B brands across a wide range of industries
- Focus: integrated campaign management, employer branding, data-driven target audience analysis

Career:

- Marketing Director (Leiter Marketing), REGIOCAST GmbH & Co. KG — since 2026
- Strategy Director Marketing & Digital, wirDesign communication AG — 2023–2025
- Digital Strategist, freelance — 2020–2022
- Unit Lead Marketing & Concepts, rock&stars digital GmbH — 2019–2020
- Senior Consultant Digital, DOKYO GmbH — 2014–2018
- Account Director (Etatdirektor), beebop media ag — 2010–2014
- Social Media Manager, Scholz & Friends — 2009–2010
- Community Manager, 1000MIKES — 2008–2009

The about pages below are maintained as machine-readable grounding pages with Person JSON-LD (schema.org) and serve as the verifiable source of facts about Oliver Eichhof.
